seo.title: Animated wedding invitations that open like a real letter
seo.description: Skip Canva. Give your guests an envelope that opens, a save-the-date that slides out and a story that unfolds as they scroll — with a real RSVP dashboard, in a link you can share anywhere.
seo.ogDescription: An invitation that opens like a real letter. Personalised in ten minutes, no Canva account, shared with a single link — with a real RSVP dashboard.

hero.title: An invitation that opens like a real letter
hero.subtitle: Personalised in ten minutes, without Canva, shared with a single link — with a real RSVP dashboard your guests' answers land in.

steps.title: Buy on Etsy
steps.body: Choose your theme in our Etsy shop. Your instant download contains your activation link and a quick-start guide.

steps.title: Activate
steps.body: Enter your order number and email on our activation page. You'll get a secure sign-in link — no password to remember.

steps.title: Personalise
steps.body: Names, date, photos, your story, the programme, the venue — fill in a guided, step-by-step editor with a live preview next to every field.

steps.title: Share
steps.body: Publish, pick your link, and send it by text, email, WhatsApp or QR code. Come back anytime to edit — changes go live instantly.

themesGallery.title: Three moods, one editor
themesGallery.subtitle: Every theme runs on the same guided editor and the same RSVP dashboard — only the visuals, colours and animations change.

mariage-noir-ivoire.mood: Deep black and ivory, a wax seal and black-and-white polaroids — the elegance of a classic invitation.

mariage-terracotta-bloom.mood: Warm terracotta and sage, dried flowers and beeswax — a boho wedding with a Provence spirit.

mariage-riviera-postcard.mood: Cobalt blue, lemon and awning stripes — a postcard from the Côte d'Azur.

vsCanva.title: Not another Canva template
vsCanva.subtitle: We build the same kind of product Etsy's best-selling wedding sites offer — without their limits.

points.title: A guided editor, not a blank canvas
points.body: Nothing to drag, nothing to misalign. Every layout is guided and tested on real phones, so it can't break when you resize a photo or move a text box.

points.title: Colours that are really yours
points.body: The palette applies to the illustrations too — the envelope, the wax seal, the stamps — not just the text. Wherever it's possible, they're colourable SVGs, not fixed images.

points.title: A real RSVP dashboard
points.body: Guest names, headcounts, dietary notes, CSV export and an email alert on every reply — not a basic form with no way to see the answers.

points.title: No third-party account, ever
points.body: No Canva login, no other platform to juggle. Just your own account and your own link.

points.title: Richer animation
points.body: An envelope that flips and opens, a scrolling story told scene by scene — built for it, instead of a static page with a few effects bolted on.

items.q: How long is my invitation hosted?
items.a: 18 months from the day you publish it — more than enough for the engagement, the wedding day and sharing photos afterwards. Hosting extensions are available separately whenever you need more time.
The editor and every invitation are fully bilingual, English and French. Choose your guests' language when you publish; changing it later takes one click.

items.q: Is there really an RSVP form?
items.a: Yes — a built-in RSVP with a live dashboard: who's coming, headcounts, dietary notes, CSV export, and an email notification each time a guest replies.
Anytime. Every change goes live immediately on your existing link — nothing to republish, nothing to re-send to your guests.

items.q: What happens to my guests' data?
items.a: Only what's needed for the RSVP: name, email, headcount, dietary notes if you ask for them. It's hosted in the EU, never sold or used for advertising, and deleted automatically a few months after your event — sooner on request.

items.q: Will it work on my guests' phones?
items.a: Yes — the whole experience is built mobile-first and tested on iOS and Android, which is how nearly all of your guests will open it.

finalCta.title: Ready when you are
finalCta.body: Pick a theme on our Etsy shop, or activate a purchase you already made.
